name: smwsprites-drifting-falling-platforms
title: Drifting Falling Platforms
description:
A simple platform which careens to the left or to the right when it spawns, and starts falling straight down when Mario steps on it.

6 cfg files are included:
drift_plat_2tiles_l.cfg
drift_plat_3tiles_l.cfg
drift_plat_4tiles_l.cfg

drift_plat_2tiles_r.cfg
drift_plat_3tiles_r.cfg
drift_plat_4tiles_r.cfg

"""Ported""" from the Platform Megapack.

Now PIXI compatible.
